title: Which atom may exceed an octet?
hints: Count bonds to the central atom.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: In $\ce{SF6}$ the center has six S–F bonds, or twelve bonding electrons around sulfur.
statement:
Which central atom in the stated species is drawn with more than eight valence-shell electrons in the customary Lewis structure?

[_]{a}

explanations: Sulfur is in Period 3 and the Lewis diagram is hypervalent.
